notes.title: Lovecraftian Days and game development showcase!
notes.notes:
Dear fellow cosmic horror enthusiasts, I’m thrilled to announce you that the Lovecraftian Days are here!
During this otherworldly event I will stream a timelapse video about my upcoming game, with behind-the-scenes glimpses into the game's creation. 

[h3]Q&A[/h3]
During the livestream I will be available to answer your questions and talk about the development. Feel free to talk with with me in the broadcast chat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/8af4cce7d7db31bc58478531e355ee58ef5b54e6.jpg[/img]
[h3]Unreal Engine 5[/h3]
I am developing the game with Unreal Engine 5, that allows to reach next-gen graphics through cutting-edge features such as: 
- Lumen Global Illumination: dynamic lighting that adapts to your every move, creating stunningly realistic scenes.
- Nanite Virtualized Geometry: a  system which allows to obtain an incredible level of detail for every object in the game. Nanite  to obtain an incredible level of detail without sacrificing performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/8b353054f57aa452ea9aed4ef4b9bb2902a83bf4.jpg[/img]
[h3]About my new game[/h3]
This is going to be a cosmic-horror game focused on story and mystery, with realistic graphics and an immersive atmosphere.
In this chilling adventure you will have to face the inevitability of fate while exploring disturbing places, finding clues and studying ancient mysteries. 
Like my previous games, The Land of Pain and The Alien Cube, the game is inspired by Lovecraftian literature.

[h3]🔮 Why Lovecraft?[/h3]
H.P. Lovecraft's cosmic horror legacy continues to captivate and terrify. His influence echoes through the ages, inspiring authors, artists and game developers from all over the world. Lovecraft’s macabre imagination has been inspiring for my works too, in particular his ability to place emphasis on the terror of the unknowable and incomprehensible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/3fe9069448ed1c43d98492cf130e6b3462c36245.jpg[/img]
[h3]Stay Tuned[/h3]
Follow our social media channels for updates, teasers and exclusive content. 
Last but not least, the Cosmic Horror Bundle will be on sale for the entire duration if the event!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23128/Cosmic_Horror_Bundle/

notes.title: Devlog - Updates on my third project
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 
here I am with some news on my next game! After The Alien Cube and The Land of Pain I am now working on my third game, a first person horror adventure with Lovecraftian lore and extraterrestrial vibes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/e00e9a387f903bcef25a365f51f3b5bffd701b71.jpg[/img]
[h3]The level design[/h3]

To realize my project I am using Unreal Engine 5 and its latest technologies such as Nanite and Lumen.

Nanite is a virtualized geometry system which allows to obtain an incredible level of detail for every object in the game.

Lumen is a dynamic global illumination and reflections system that allows for very accurate and realistic lighting. Both technologies help developers reaching the best results in terms of graphics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/dc33e5a7f171af3cd1bdf71dd3630048afddfd33.jpg[/img]
In this moment I am building big natural environments that the player will be able to explore while trying to unveil the mysteries that surround the place. There will be also interiors and disturbing underground structures to discover, where ancient secrets will come to light after being buried for years.

[h3]The story[/h3]

The protagonist, a university student keen on ancient mysteries, is investigating strange phenomena that occur only at a certain time of the year in a nearby forest. This time the episodes are weirder than usual and it looks like someone else is keeping an eye on them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/f580275fbccb7428b94251b38b8fc8c04e565be5.jpg[/img]
PS: tomorrow it's The Land of Pain's 6th anniversary and to celebrate this event all my games are on sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23128/Cosmic_Horror_Bundle/

To be up-to-date with the latest news on my upcoming game follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/GuzzoProds]TWITTER [/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/guzzoproductions/?hl]INSTAGRAM [/url]and my [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GuzzoProductions]STEAM DEVELOPER PAGE[/url]!

notes.title: LOVECRAFT EVENT & NEW GAME REVEAL
notes.notes:
The Lovecraft Tag event on Steam has just begun! 
To celebrate this special moment, the game has been updated with an in-game event as a tribute to the most important source of inspiration for my games: H.P. Lovecraft.
He was a writer of horror and weird stories, born in Providence in 1890.
He is mostly known for the creation of the Cthulhu Mythos. In his tales he made frequent references to ancient and powerful gods called the "Great Old Ones". 
Lovecraft’s macabre imagination has been inspiring for my works, in particular his ability to convey a feeling of insignificance that characterizes man's place in the universe. His protagonists have to deal with a horrifying truth that should not be revealed to humanity.

[h3]THE INGAME EVENT:[/h3]
It consists in a new main menu theme and a secret drawing that I’ve hidden somewhere in the game. Search everywhere and find it!
This event will last one month.

[h3]GAME UPDATE:[/h3]
The game has also been updated with bug fixes and general improvements.

[h3]MY NEXT PROJECT:[/h3]
Are you curious to see something about my next game? Here are a few sneak peeks for you:

Leave a comment and let me know what you think! ;)
Like my previous games, it is a first person horror adventure with a strong focus on Lovecraftian vibes. It’s a very ambitious project and I can’t wait to share with you a lot more in the next future!

notes.title: FIND THE HIDDEN ARTIFACTS TO UNLOCK BONUS SECRETS!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/77b478654222aaedd214f5e004c166012e3839fd.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone! Have you ever wondered what the protagonist of The Alien Cube looks like? And how about his uncle Edgar and other characters in the story?
Now you can discover this and much more by finding the secret statuettes that are hidden in every chapter. 
This new content is to thank you all for your amazing support and for having voted The Alien Cube as the winner of CryEngine GOTY! ːsteamhappyː

[u]HOW THE SECRETS WORK:[/u]
They are not achievements, they are objects that Arthur carries with him. This means that they are stored in the savegame, so if you start a new game or select a chapter from the menu, the secrets unlocked will reset.

Every secret unlocks a drawing that reveals something more about the game and its characters. You can see them by selecting “Secrets” in the menu.

Here is a preview of Edgar’s portrait. To reveal his face, find three artifacts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/e883ced0ff0b6b0060defa041f83e2af91c6fa40.png[/img]

Will you be able to find them all? ;)

notes.title: Snowy Map with Survival + Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
This has been quite a cold winter where I come from so, to celebrate the end of the year, I’ve decided to talk to you about the snowy map in The Alien Cube! 
In the game there are different environments such as forests, dungeons, buildings and much more. Arthur, the protagonist, not only will have to investigate and escape from dangerous threats, but also survive extreme weather conditions. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/971f52a97070fd9c2a630eec6c33a81b0bd5dd74.jpg[/img]

There will be snowy areas where Arthur will have to survive the cold. While exploring impervious places and walking through blizzards, the player must be careful not to freeze and find some shelter, or a way to warm up.

notes.title: Play the Demo at the Steam Game Festival!
notes.notes:
[h2]About The Alien Cube:[/h2]
A disturbing reality is about to be unveiled, something that mankind should never know. After a mysterious finding, unexplainable facts occur and strange happenings will lead you to doubt the world around you. Uncover an otherworldly secret and explore forbidden places to find out the truth. 
Main Features
SURVIVE -- Wander in snowy forests, face hostile weather conditions and travel through otherworldly places and creepy dungeons.
LOVECRAFTIAN HORROR -- Experience an atmosphere of decay and terror, trying to delve into an incomprehensible reality.
EXPLORE & INTERACT -- Discover horrifying places, find items to solve puzzles and seek out clues to help unravel the mystery.
BEAUTIFUL VISUALS -- CryEngine 5-powered graphics with photogrammetric technology allows powerful visuals.
IMMERSIVE AUDIO -- An atmospheric soundtrack and high quality ambient sounds will give you a true horror experience.
THE LAND OF PAIN -- Investigate your uncle, the protagonist of the game The Land of Pain. Discover the truth about his past and find how these two games are connected.

[h2]Download the demo now![/h2]
What are you waiting for? The demo is already available, download it on the game's page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099220/The_Alien_Cube/

The Alien Cube will be released in spring 2021. While you’re waiting for the release, play previous game: The Land of Pain! It is now 50% off, so don’t miss this chance!
